note: MAU2-associated CdLS (CdLS7) characteristically presents with microcephaly, short stature, and craniofacial dysmorphism without the severe limb reduction defects classic of severe NIPBL cases.

evidence.text: Characterization of 18 individuals with MAU2 variants showed presentations spanning classic to milder CdLS with short stature and microcephaly as consistent features rather than prominent structural limb reduction anomalies.

source.title: Pathogenic variants in the cohesin loader subunit MAU2 lead to a new Cornelia de Lange Syndrome subtype
source.quote: Affected individuals display a wide range of phenotypes, from classic CdLS to milder presentations, with short stature and microcephaly as consistent features.

evidence.text: Disruption of the NIPBL-MAU2 interaction in CdLS cohorts correlates with clinical presentations where severe structural limb reductions are absent.

source.title: Isolated NIBPL missense mutations that cause Cornelia de Lange syndrome alter MAU2 interaction
